correctness.rationale: For Q5 with Hamming metric and Čech scale 4, closed radius-2 balls contain 16 vertices each and the nerve is the union of all nonempty ball subsets. Independently rebuilt all 1,910,200 distinct nonempty face masks of the 32 balls, the deterministic increasing-vertex then increasing-face one-bit matching, yielding 955,064 distinct face pairs and 72 unmatched faces (one vertex, eleven 4-faces, sixty 6-faces). Built and traversed all 15,768,064 oriented Hasse cover edges under matching reversal: Kahn topological sorting visited every 1,910,200 faces, proving acyclicity, not merely matching Betti counts. Forman gives a CW complex with critical cells; absent adjacent positive-dimensional cells force zero cellular differentials, so H4=Z^11,H6=Z^60 and no other reduced homology. Rank lower bounds force any CW model at least 72 cells; this is attained. The 6-cell attaching maps live in π5(∨11S4)≅(Z/2)^11, and Smith-style mod-2 row/column simplification via integral unimodular maps yields a wedge of t Σ²CP², 11−t S4, 60−t S6 with 0≤t≤11, t=rank(Sq²:H4→H6). t remains *unknown*; no wedge-of-spheres conclusion. C++17 source matches independently reconstructed result; stored output alone was not used as proof.
residual_risks: No computed Sq² rank; no claim X is a wedge solely of spheres, PL collapsible or the source stronger 7-collapsibility conjecture.
